The mandatory reviewed docs/EXECUTION-EFFICIENCY-ARCHITECTURE.md is not a v0.10 content_hash entry, is not a protected manifest, and does not match either mutable prefix. It changed from SHA-256 24fe09... in review 001 to 4fe8f0... after the 22:03:17Z ESIS amendment while the immutable-boundary draft remained byte-identical. A conservative whole-package classification finds 13 UNCLASSIFIED files (12 excluding PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json), including multiple v0.11 draft/evaluation paths. Parent history is still intact, but the guardrail's own exact-universe claim cannot meet target zero as written.
